summary: Diff implements a manual-auth flow with localStorage-backed sessions/accounts, redirects signup/login to /profile-setup when profile is incomplete, and adds jobseeker experience-entry data structures plus part of a Profile Setup page with up-to-5 experience entries. However, several acceptance-criteria details (notably explicit Email field in Profile Setup, verified fresher/experienced UI behavior, and confirmed post-submit routing + persistence updates) are not fully evidenced in the provided diff summary, and a few unrequested features (admin login, role setup modal, Internet Identity help dialog) appear to be introduced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Profile Setup for role=jobseeker must collect Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Current Location, and an Experience Status dropdown (Fresher/Experienced).
missing_requirements.reason: ProfileSetupPage validation uses session?.email but the diff excerpt does not show an Email ID input being rendered/collected in the jobseeker form UI.

missing_requirements.requirement: When Experience Status = Fresher, the experience-entry UI is hidden and no experience entries are required; when Experienced, show experience-entry UI with add/edit/remove up to 5 and prevent adding a 6th with clear English validation messaging.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows add/remove/update functions and the 5-entry limit error message, but the excerpt is truncated before any UI conditional rendering based on Fresher/Experienced is visible.

missing_requirements.requirement: On successful Profile Setup submit, navigate to /jobseeker/dashboard (jobseeker) or /employer/candidates (employer), and persist manual-auth stored state so the user is not repeatedly redirected back to /profile-setup after refresh.
missing_requirements.reason: ProfileSetupPage imports markProfileComplete and useNavigate, but the provided excerpt is truncated before showing the success path that calls markProfileComplete and performs the required role-based navigation. useManualAuth implementation is also truncated before showing markProfileComplete behavior updating storage.

missing_requirements.requirement: Protected routes must not get stuck rendering only a loading indicator due to profile completeness checks; if profile completeness cannot be determined via backend, fall back to manual-auth stored state and do not block with an infinite spinner.
missing_requirements.reason: ProtectedRoute explicitly navigates to /profile-setup and returns a spinner while redirecting; the diff summary does not show any additional guard to prevent repeated redirects/spinner loops in edge cases (e.g., if /profile-setup is itself protected by a role-based ProtectedRoute, or if navigation triggers re-renders).

hallucinated_features.description: Admin role added to manual auth types and Login UI includes an Admin tab/route handling.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on jobseeker/employer manual auth and profile setup; admin login/role is not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: RoleSetupModal feature that saves a profile via a two-step modal for first-time users.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest specifies routing to a dedicated /profile-setup page after signup/login; a separate role-setup modal flow is not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: InternetIdentityHelpDialog UI component explaining Internet Identity.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraints explicitly say not to use Internet Identity, but do not request adding explanatory UI/help content about it.
